Stefan's crackling pork roastPork shoulder roasted with crackling, apples and potatoesHow to make it2kg pork shoulder2 tbsp sea salt flakes4 green apples, halved1kg potatoes, in chunks2 tbsp olive oil2 bunches of broccoliniScore the pork skin and rub with salt.Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry out.Roast at 160°C for the first part of the cooking.Chop the potatoes and halve the apples, toss with oil, and add to the pan.Roast for the last hour.Blast at 240°C until the crackling bubbles.Rest the pork.Steam the broccolini and serve on a long platter.Woodland cottage shepherd's stock, and simmer 25 minutes until thick.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk.Spread the lamb in a dish, top with mash, scatter with 60g cheddar and bake at 200°C for 25
